template.description: Name of the template to use. t1 'ATS Classic': conservative navy, non-italic, experience-before-education order — built for ATS parsing and the Moroccan/French hiring convention. t2 'Navy Rule': editorial, teal-accented, tracked uppercase headings. t3 'Modern Minimal': compact, indigo-accented, no rule under headings, en-dash bullets.

fileName.description: Output file name (without extension); path components are stripped.

jobTitle.description: Optional. Shown under the name (e.g. "Software Engineer").

specialties.description: Optional. Short specialty tags shown under the job title.

photo.description: Optional. Path to a local image file, resolved relative to the input JSON's directory.

profile.description: Optional. A short summary paragraph shown near the top of the CV.

skills.description: Optional. Technical skills grouped by category.

certifications.description: Optional. Flat list of certification titles, e.g. "AWS Certified Solutions Architect — Amazon".

settings.description: Optional. Per-entry presentation options — language, section visibility/order, and color overrides. Every field is independent; omit anything you want the template's default for. CLI flags (see the generate command) override the same setting when both are given.

lang.description: Optional. Template label language (headings, "Stack:", date separator). Does not translate your content. Default: en.

density.description: Optional. Spacing scale: dense (0.85x), normal (1x, default), airy (1.15x).

sections.description: Optional. Per-section visibility/order overrides. education, experience and languages have no "include" (the schema already requires at least one entry) but can still be reordered.

sectionSetting.description: Set include, priority, and/or per-section style for one section. priority: lower renders first; sections not mentioned keep the template's default order.

sectionStyle.description: Per-section style overrides (the "Section Overrides" layer of Global Template Defaults -> Section Overrides -> Rendered Section). Every field is optional and inherits the template's value when omitted.

divider.description: false removes this section's heading rule; true forces it on.

spaceBefore.description: Vertical gap (points) before this section, overriding the default rhythm.

uppercase.description: Override whether this section's heading is upper-cased.

colorSettings.description: Overrides the template's semantic color palette. Each value is a hex color, e.g. "#1F3864" (the "#" is optional); omit a role to keep the template's default. The four legacy keys (accent/grey/muted/ink) still work and map onto the semantic roles (accent -> headline + border, grey -> metadata, muted -> profile, ink -> body); if both a legacy key and its semantic role are set, the semantic value wins.

headline.description: Section headings, the name, and the "Stack:" label.

subheadline.description: The tagline/role line under the name.

body.description: Body copy, entry titles, bullets, skills, contact.

background.description: Page background (drawn only when not white).
